description: This file contains the implementation of the MediaPipelineTestBase class, which provides a base for unit testing media pipeline components. It includes mock object setup, media pipeline creation and destruction, and methods to simulate media source attachment, EOS handling, and data notification expectations.

classes.name: MediaPipelineTestBase
classes.description: A base class for media pipeline unit tests, providing setup, teardown, and utility methods for testing media pipeline behavior.

methods.name: MediaPipelineTestBase::MediaPipelineTestBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing mock objects and internal state.

methods.name: MediaPipelineTestBase::createMediaPipeline
methods.description: Creates and initializes the media pipeline object with mocked dependencies.

methods.name: MediaPipelineTestBase::destroyMediaPipeline
methods.description: Destroys the media pipeline and cleans up resources.

methods.name: MediaPipelineTestBase::mainThreadWillEnqueueTask
methods.description: Sets expectation for enqueuing a task on the main thread.

methods.name: MediaPipelineTestBase::mainThreadWillEnqueueTaskAndWait
methods.description: Sets expectation for enqueuing a task and waiting on the main thread.

methods.name: MediaPipelineTestBase::loadGstPlayer
methods.description: Loads a mock GStreamer player and triggers the loading process.

methods.name: MediaPipelineTestBase::attachSource
methods.description: Attaches a media source (audio or video) to the pipeline.

methods.name: MediaPipelineTestBase::setEos
methods.description: Simulates end-of-stream for a media source.

methods.name: MediaPipelineTestBase::expectNotifyNeedData
methods.description: Sets expectations for notifying the need for media data.

methods.name: MediaPipelineTestBase::expectNotifyNeedDataEos
methods.description: Sets expectations for notifying end-of-stream media data.
